text: player
Valentine's Day
Flower Seller
Good day! Come take a look – pick a gorgeous bouquet for your loved one! Valentine's Day is here, and we have special discounts today!
The flower sellers on the street are hawking their blooms with extra gusto today.//nBut hey, can you blame them? After all, it's Valentine's Day.
Cynthia
I have back-to-back shoots lately, so I'm afraid we won't be able to go out together until a few days later. Sorry...
Let me see... According to my schedule, my next day off is... this day. How does that sound?
Was Cynthia really unaware that it would be Valentine's today? Or...
Welcome! Looking for flowers today?
You seem like you've got something on your mind. Thinking about someone special?
Oh, I'm fine. Just passing by.
Even if you say she's someone special...
What would you like? Something to represent pure innocence, like these lovely irises? Or the soft tenderness of tulips? Or... are we aiming for a bold statement of love with these red roses?
It's Valentine's Day today, so you can get a discount if you buy more!
I've been fretting about what gift to buy for Cynthia for days, but as a supermodel, she probably gets bouquets all the time. Maybe I should surprise her with something unexpected.
Sorry, I'm not planning to buy any flowers.
This person has such a way with words... One minute I'm impressed, and the next, I'm right back to agonizing over what gift to get.
What's more, as I've been running around all morning trying to find the perfect gift, my stomach is growling with hunger...
Loudspeaker
Get it now! Cynthia's limited-edition T-shirt for charity sale! Back for a short time only – don't miss out!
Huh? What's that loudspeaker saying? People are starting to gather over there.
Buy one now, and you'll have the chance to get...
To get... what?
...an exclusive poster signed by Cynthia!
Crowd
Yay!
Ahhhhhhh!
The crowd is pushing me away!
I know Cynthia's got a big following, but isn't this kind of crazy?!
I must get an exclusive poster!
I'm not gonna wait in that line for it...
Never mind food for now! Limited merch is the real feast for the soul!
That said...
Is this line really moving?
Since I don't have anything else to do, maybe I should give Cynthia a call...
She should be happy to find out that so many people are lining up to buy her charity T-shirt.
Speaking of which... these fans in line probably have no idea that I'm calling Cynthia.
It's better to keep a low profile, or else who knows what these people would do in their jealousy...
player
I'm in line to buy your charity T-shirt. Apparently, I'll get a poster signed by you if I buy one today.
I've heard about that. The charity T-shirts sold out very fast, so they brought them back for another run today.
Just know you're swamped with work, so... yeah!
Hah... sometimes I just don't understand that mind of yours. Anyway, our plan for tonight hasn't changed. Don't be late.
Okay, talk to you later!
The first charity sale Cynthia mentioned was held shortly after the charity gala. Her T-shirt got such a great response that it was brought back as an additional item to help raise funds.
Oh, right...
Amid that heavy summer rain, the neon lights in the distance bled into a hazy blur...
And Cynthia and I, soaking wet from scrambling to save the shipping boxes, had no choice but to throw on those charity T-shirts for the time being.
I was so caught up in the moment, it completely slipped my mind that I was wearing what looked like a matching couple T-shirt with a popular model...
Cynthia's Studio
It might be because it's wet, but this label is driving me nuts now – my neck is so itchy I can barely stand it.
Phew – that should be the last one. We're finally finished.
You've been fiddling with your collar for a while now. What did it ever do to you?
Or... do you want to wear the one I'm wearing?
Um... the label is a little...
I really thought we were working with a reliable clothing supplier this time...
Cynthia, who was leaning against the wall, suddenly straightens up and walks over to me.
Well, as the quality inspector, I guess it is my responsibility to personally check whether the products meet the standards.
Bang!//nMy back hits the cool wall, and her wet hair brushes my face.
Don't move. I'll take it off for you soon.
(Isn't this a little too close...?)
She's standing so close to me that I can sense the warmth of her body.
A gentle tingle spreads across my cheeks, and my heart suddenly skips a beat for reasons I can't explain...
Charity Sale Volunteer
Hello? ...Hello?
How did that happen?!
Did I line up for all that time for nothing?
I'm really sorry...! There's still one last poster though... You can have it for free.
As compensation, we'd also like to give you a dining voucher for the mall nearby. Please, we insist!
Oh? All I wanted was the poster anyway. Guess I'm quite lucky.
That said, I still have no clue what to get Cynthia, and that unexpected dining voucher just kicked my hunger into overdrive... So...
Maybe I should get a beautiful dessert as her gift.
Let me eat something first!
Clerk
Dessert Shop
The Valentine's atmosphere is strong here too... Which one should I get for Cynthia? My gaze naturally falls on the most gorgeous cake.
This thing is clearly way more exquisite than the other cakes! This might just be a sneaky marketing trap...
But it's still a limited-edition Valentine's Day cake. Would it be out of line to buy something this extravagant?
As I'm thinking that, the memory of a previous meal with Cynthia flashes through my mind.
Yes, this is so nice. The smell of baking in this place feels so soothing.
After surviving this crazy week, I absolutely deserve some desserts.
Don't you need to control your calorie intake to maintain your figure?
Geez...
But within those tight calorie limits, keeping your spirits up matters just as much.
If you push yourself too hard, even the most professional forced smile can't hide that flicker of frustration – people will notice.
That's so strict...
Mmhm, now's the time for me to recharge – which is exactly why I brought you here to try out these desserts.
Eating alone has its charm, but for a real recharge, sharing these with you makes all the difference.
Um...
Just kidding. I've got to do an ad read tomorrow, and too much sugar will mess up my voice.
Just a little should be fine.
Um... yeah, but I didn't think I would need to practice pronunciation when I started out.
To perfect my pronunciation, I even have to practice saying the vowels. Do you know what the first vowel syllable is?
Huh? It should be "ah"... Huh...?!
The moment I open my lips, something soft and sweet fills my mouth.
Cynthia had scooped some cream off the cake and fed it to me.
Her smile is all I can see at that moment.
Um... excuse me, have you found anything you like?
The clerk's question brings me back to the present, though the memory does remind me that models need to control their calorie intake.
After all, we're having dinner tonight. The last thing I want is to make Cynthia stress over her calorie count.
I leave the dessert shop quickly without picking a gift. Time is running out.
What does Cynthia like? Has she ever mentioned it before...
I search my memories desperately, but all I remember are the beautiful moments I've spent with her.
As my gaze sweeps the area in frustration, something catches my eye – a panda plushie peeking from a nearby shop window.
I know! Pandas! Cynthia told me she loves pandas.
Perhaps my hands are just too full. The poster breaks free when a gust of evening wind blows past.
Hey, wait!
The poster skims along the ground for a moment, then the wind lifts it into the air and it quickly falls back down.
I lunge for it, but can only reach out with one hand – I still need to protect the panda plushie in my arms. My momentum carries me forward, sending me into a slide on the pavement on my knees...
Got you!
You're in a bit of a sorry state, {var:player_nickname}.
That voice...
Cynthia?
Huh? Why are you here...?
I have a habit of being early.
The traffic is jammed everywhere at this time, so it's faster to take the subway.
Huh? Did you finish work early today?
Yeah, I tried to speed it up as much as possible.
Because I didn't want you to wait too long.
What are you just standing there for? Let's go.
Cynthia, this is for you!
Pfft! I saw it from far away. So it's for me? Thank you.
Um, there's something I need to know!
Huh? What is it?
Cynthia... Did you know it's Valentine's Day today?!
You stuttered just now!
Your reaction... is so suspicious...
Oh come on, so what if it's Valentine's Day?
Well then this is my Valentine's Day gift for you.
Happy Valentine's Day, Cynthia.
You sure are bold, {var:player_nickname}.
As the evening breeze caresses her smooth hair, time seems to slow down at this moment.
A light rail train thunders past, roaring as it approaches before fading into the distance. Yet, Cynthia's words cut through it all with perfect clarity.
Yeah, Happy Valentine's Day.
Her gaze is firm and gentle as she says those words.
What I need to do now is eat!
As I bite into the double cheeseburger, savory juices and sauce drip through my fingers onto the plate.
So warm, so satisfied... Suddenly, all my pent-up fatigue seems to rise...
Ugh... I can't... suddenly so sleepy...
Soon, I'm back home from the noisy streets, slipping into my warm, cozy bed.
Yawn...
My eyelids are too heavy to keep open, but I can't shake this feeling I'm forgetting something important...
When I wake up, my phone shows 17:00.
...And outside the window, the sky has already taken on a reddish hue.
What's even more terrifying is that... I have three missed calls from Cynthia.
Somewhere in One Han City

I told Cynthia I'd bring her a gift the next time we got together, especially with how much she's been putting in recently. Little did I know it'd be Valentine's Day of all days...//nThere's nothing I can do about it, though. Cynthia's modeling work is way busier than I thought.
Okay, it's settled then. I'm going to make a reservation at that restaurant I've always wanted to try. Just don't you dare stand me up, alright?
Not to worry! We're all about honest dealing here. Our prices are fair, and we have a great selection of flowers for any occasion.
That's such a shame. Still, I wish you all the best in love.
Wait a minute, my top priority now should be...
Feels like I haven't budged an inch, even though ages have passed.
Oh, it's you. Why aren't you saying anything? Calls made during work hours are charged according to my hourly rate, you know.
But... do you really need to wait in line for a signed poster? I could just sign one for you later.
Lining up is how a fan shows their enthusiasm!
Hmm... I guess you're right. I've been doing photo shoots at the studio nonstop. Our plan for tonight hasn't changed, though. Don't be late.
You still remember the restaurant I booked, right? Dinner's on me tonight. I've been meaning to thank you properly since that first charity sale, and tonight's the night!
Alright then... Okay! Coming! ...It's getting busy over here again, so let's catch up later?
Good luck with your work! Let's talk later!
Aha, I knew it. The label is the culprit.
Come to think of it. On that day, Cynthia seemed to have said that she would treat me to a meal to thank me for helping...
Though it happened quite a while back, it still feels vivid in my mind.
Sorry, Cynthia's charity T-shirts are already sold out. The customer in front of you bought the last one...
Welcome! We're doing a special promotion for Valentine's Day. What would you like?
Oh, you have such good taste. This cake is our special Valentine's Day cake for two. It's perfect for celebrating the day with your loved one!
True, dietary control is crucial for models – down to the last digit even...
How's the flavor? I have good taste, huh?
I'm sorry! Maybe next time!
(Geez! Now's not the time to think about these things!)
This is it. This will definitely do! This is the perfect Valentine's Day gift!
With this thought in mind, I start walking briskly toward the gift shop.

The good news? I got the perfect gift, no sweat at all.//nThe bad news? I'm currently wrestling a panda plushie the size of a small child while trying not to crease Cynthia's signed poster. Let's just say getting around isn't exactly a breeze right now.
This is totally my kind of thing. You should be starving by now. Let's talk after we get to the restaurant.
O-Of course I know! These commercialized holidays are...
Just a quick nap at home, and I'll get back up and keep looking...
Shoot! If I don't get going now, I'm seriously gonna be late!
Restaurant
(The face on the poster overlaps with the face in front of me...)
